title: Composition of adjunctions and of coefficient comparisons
statement:
Work in the standing scheme setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: $k$ is a field of characteristic $p>0$, $\ell\ne p$ is prime, all schemes are separated of finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be smooth of pure relative dimensions $d,e\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $A\to B$ be a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$. Use ordinary uncompleted constant-ring module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Here $\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},R)$ consists of complexes with bounded intrinsically constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude], and $S_TK=K_B=K\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ with its $B_T$-action [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor]. Write $F_{h,R}=Rh_{!,R}$ and $H_{h,R}=h_R^!$, with their constructible adjunctions [sk-prop-sf-rf-shriek-preservation], and use the canonical coefficient maps $b_h:S F_{h,A}\xrightarrow\sim F_{h,B}S$ and $c_h:S H_{h,A}\xrightarrow\sim H_{h,B}S$ of [det-sp-reduction-direct-image, det-sp-reduction-exceptional]. Compactifications and their comparisons are coefficient independent.

1. There is the canonical compact-support compositor $\alpha_R:F_{g,R}F_{f,R}\xrightarrow\sim F_{gf,R}$, normalized by proper direct-image composition, open extension and proper/open interchange. The canonical isomorphism $\theta_R:H_{gf,R}\xrightarrow\sim H_{f,R}H_{g,R}$ is the unique one identifying the adjunction for $F_{gf,R}$ with the composite adjunction via $\alpha_R$. The latter has counit
$$\varepsilon^{\mathrm{comp}}_R(K)=\varepsilon_{g,R}(K)\circ F_{g,R}(\varepsilon_{f,R}(H_{g,R}K)).$$
2. For $M\in\Dctf(X_{\mathrm{proét}},A)$ the following equality is in the $B$-module derived category on $Z$:
$$b_{gf}(M)\circ S_Z(\alpha_A(M))=\alpha_B(S_XM)\circ F_{g,B}(b_f(M))\circ b_g(F_{f,A}M).$$
For $K\in\Dctf(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},A)$, the following equality is in the $B$-module derived category on $X$:
$$\theta_B(S_ZK)\circ c_{gf}(K)=H_{f,B}(c_g(K))\circ c_f(H_{g,A}K)\circ S_X(\theta_A(K)).$$
Thus after these specified composition identifications the equations are precisely $b^{gf}=Rg_{!,B}(b^f)\circ b^g$ and $c^{gf}=f_B^!(c^g)\circ c^f$; no flatness or finite projective dimension of $B$ over $A$ is imposed.
3. For a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], put $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$, $n\geq1$. In the ordinary derived category of strict varying-coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], restricted to uniformly bounded constructible finite-Tor towers [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], there are actual composition isomorphisms $F_{g,\bullet}F_{f,\bullet}\simeq F_{gf,\bullet}$ and $H_{gf,\bullet}\simeq H_{f,\bullet}H_{g,\bullet}$. Here the functors are [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels, det-sp-tower-gluing]. Their evaluations are $\alpha_{A_n}$ and $\theta_{A_n}$, including their counit normalizations; they respect the derived reduction maps $C_n\otimes^L_{A_n}A_m\to C_m$ and restrict to normalized towers. For the integral assertion use the global finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For $E=\mathbf Q_\ell$, the reduction/$R\varprojlim$ equivalence [det-sp-normalized-equivalence] yields
$$R(gf)_{!,\mathbf Z_\ell}\simeq Rg_{!,\mathbf Z_\ell}Rf_{!,\mathbf Z_\ell},\qquad (gf)^!_{\mathbf Z_\ell}\simeq f^!_{\mathbf Z_\ell}g^!_{\mathbf Z_\ell}$$
on the derived-complete integral constructible categories $\Dbc(-,\mathbf Z_\ell)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], with the functors and adjunctions identified as in [det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower, det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection].

proof.text: For each of f, g and fg, apply reductionExceptional_isIso to obtain the actual finite support restrictions, exceptional adjunctions, scalar closure and invertible counit-mate coefficient comparisons. The compactification middle schemes inherit their separated finite-type structure over k. Lift reductionDirectImageComparison componentwise to the full constructible categories using reductionDirectImage_isIso; the inverse is fixed by the hom normalization. The existing exceptional counit equation gives the full-subcategory equation by hom_ext.

Finite type over the field and quasi-compactness give Noetherian X,Y,Z. Apply the normalized finite support compositor existence theorem for each ring, retaining exactly the adjunctions from the first step. Apply the coefficient theorem and lift its ambient equation by hom_ext. These construct DA, DB and the left composition equation.

Apply finiteAdjointCompositorTransposes to DA, DB and the three specified b and c isomorphisms. Keep its normalized right compositors, uniqueness, composite counits and coefficient equation, omitting only the extra displayed intermediate transpose formula. Assemble these fields into SpCompositionFinite.

For each actual quotient ring R_n, construct a normalized support compositor using the existing finite adjunctions of the supplied tower levels, not independently chosen right adjoints. Quotient rings are annihilated by ell^(n+1). The left coefficient theorem gives the quotient comparison equation. The specified exceptional coefficientMate has its defining counit equation by the Hom equivalence. Its pointwise invertibility from Levels, and naturality proved by injectivity of this Hom equivalence, give a natural isomorphism. Apply the finite transpose theorem at levels n,m. Its uniqueness identifies its right compositors with finiteTheta, whose normalization follows from rightAdjointUniq. Thus obtain both FiniteIdentities, including m=n, and apply towerAdjointCompositorRealization to obtain all tower laws.

For the integral assertion, use the fully faithful reduction and the left/right comparison isomorphisms in the three given integral-adjunction realization records. Paste b_g(F_f -), F_g(b_f), alphaTower and inverse b_gf to obtain an isomorphism after reduction. Lift it uniquely through the fully faithful functor on functor categories. map_preimage gives the left reduction equation. Transport the direct integral adjunction along inverse alpha and take rightAdjointUniq with the composite adjunction. This gives the integral counit normalization. The private evaluated_compositor calculation in the actual tower compositor module applies to the three reduction comparison squares: its unit and counit hypotheses follow by cancellation from the Realization unit_reduction and counit_reduction fields. It gives the right reduction equation by two applications of the Hom bijection and the supplied tower counit equation. Finally injectivity of the composite Hom bijection proves uniqueness, and Adjunction.comp_counit_app gives the composite counit. These are explicit maps of the published integral functors. No finite evaluation is assumed faithful.

Old steps 4-5 are exactly the pro-étale b-composition and refinement equations of the existing lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility, for arbitrary A→B with no flatness. Old steps 3+6, 7-9 and 10 become the three new nodes (2577, 3222 and 2770 characters). The parent proof is a short assembly (2316 characters, 2703 after the fix). Each new node assumes the earlier pieces as hypotheses and none restates the item. The tower node matches det-sp-tower-gluing (2)-(3), lem-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-calculus (1),(3) and sk-lem-sp-tower-bound, and assumes no faithfulness of finite evaluation. In the integral node, the κ_Y direction, the normalization of F_f r_X and H_g r_Z, and the k=F̄_q, ℓ-invertible and Noetherian hypotheses of det-sp-normalized-equivalence and det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection all check. Other candidates (sf adic compositor, rational scalar compatibility, cbc tower realization) concern other objects. No cycles; the trace-formula/Poincaré-duality closure is the same on base and head (283 nodes); no SGA. Tool uses accepted: lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility and lem-sp-finite-compact-site-coherence, generic infrastructure. The repaired step proves it from ν^*(L⊗H)≅M⊗ν^*H, ν^* commuting with cohomology, and the unit H→ν_*ν^*H being invertible, citing lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback, lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact and thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison (also added to proof_deps).
